summary.text: Gary White is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 115 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Gary White's career experience includes working as a farmer.
White took office representing Kansas House District 115 on January 9, 2023, succeeding Boyd Orr.

In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture Committee, the Agriculture and Natural Resources Budget Committee, the Financial Institutions and Pensions Committee and the Pensions, Investments and Benefits Committee, and served as vice chair of the Water Committee.
In a Ballotpedia survey completed in 2022, when he first ran, White described himself as a conservative Christian farmer from Ashland.

He said in the survey that he has a degree in economics and has been an agricultural advocate for over 20 years, and he named agricultural issues, job growth, small government and low taxes, school safety and Second Amendment rights among his priorities.
